methodology.aggregation: All counts are aggregates across the whole window. No per-visitor, per-session, or per-device records are kept in this file.
methodology.collection: Publisher-attested aggregates only. No tracking script is required on pages; the publisher reports what it can honestly count.
methodology.privacy: Zero PII by design. No IPs, cookies, device IDs, or user agents appear in this file, ever.
methodology.sampling: None. When published, counts are exact publisher-attested figures — never sampled, never modeled.
